title: Theoretical Study on the Evidential Learning-based Variational Autoencoder
abstract:
arXiv:2609.27853v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A normal--inverse-gamma (NIG) latent hierarchy has four parameters, but its induced latent law does not identify all four. For $\sigma^2\sim\mathrm{InvGamma}(\alpha, eta)$, $\mu\mid\sigma^2\sim\mathcal{N}(\gamma,\sigma^2/
u)$, and $z\mid\mu,\sigma^2\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^2)$, the marginal law of $z$ depends on $(
u, eta)$ only through $c= eta(1+1/
u)$. Hence the reconstruction-visible parameter space is the three-dimensional quotient $(\gamma,\alpha,c)$, with a one-dimensional fiber degree of freedom. For a fixed hierarchical variational objective, exact partial minimization of the forward KL divergence to a complete NIG prior selects a unique prior-relative representative on each fiber, yielding an exact three-coordinate reduction with the same optimum as the four-coordinate objective. translated_title: 基于证据学习的变分自编码器的理论研究
translated_abstract: 正态-逆伽马（NIG）潜在层级结构包含四个参数，但其诱导的潜在分布并不能唯一确定全部四个参数。对于 σ²~InvGamma(α,β)，μ|σ²~N(γ, σ²/ν)，z|μ,σ²~N(μ, σ²)，z 的边际分布仅通过 c=β(1+1/ν) 依赖于 (ν, β)。因此，重构可见的参数空间是三维商空间 (γ, α, c)，并带有一维的纤维自由度。对于固定的层级变分目标，对前向KL散度到一个完整NIG先验的精确偏最小化，会在每条纤维上选择出一个唯一的先验相对代表元，从而实现精确的三坐标约简，且其最优值与四坐标目标完全相同。记 ρ₀=2β₀/ν₀，T=c/{α[(γ-γ₀)²+ρ₀]}，我们证明逆规范分配 1/ν_can……（原摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文从理论上证明，证据学习变分自编码器中正态-逆伽马潜在层级的四个参数仅有三维商空间 (γ, α, c) 是可辨识的，并且通过对前向KL散度的精确偏最小化，可以实现从四参数到三坐标的精确约简，同时保持最优值不变。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically proves that the four-parameter normal-inverse-gamma latent hierarchy in evidential-learning VAEs is identifiable only up to a three-dimensional quotient (γ, α, c), and that exact partial minimization of the forward KL divergence achieves an exact three-coordinate reduction with the same optimum as the four-parameter objective.
